description: The Rustblade Knave is a cunning rogue with a wicked sense of self-preservation. Armed with a rusting blade that corrodes armor, this knave has an aura of deceit and unpredictability, making them dangerous adversaries, especially in the shadows of urban environments.

traits.name: Rusting Blade
traits.description: The Rustblade Knave's weapon corrodes metal on contact. A creature hit by the knave’s blade must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or have their armor's AC reduced by 1. Non-magical armor is destroyed if this effect reduces its AC to 10.

traits.name: Cunning Action
traits.description: On each of its turns, the Rustblade Knave can use a bonus action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The Rustblade Knave makes two melee attacks with its rusting blade.

actions.name: Rusting Blade
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d8+4) slashing damage and the target must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or suffer the Rusting Blade trait's effect.
